text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Ngaaah... I can't concentrate.
There are way too many problems, none of this is sticking in my head.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
It's okay. If we take it one step at a time,
we'll definitely reach the goal!
First, let's start with this problem—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, Top Road.
You know you don't have to go out of your way
to help me study, right?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Please don't worry about it, I wanted to review this material too.
Let's do our best on the makeup exam!"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ...Even so, man... Aaah... I don't even know what problem I'm working on anymore...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
(......Pokke-chan looks like she's having a rough time.
It really is hard to absorb anything when you can't focus.
What on earth should I do...?)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"—And that's why.
I'm sorry for calling you out so suddenly."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much! When I was troubled,
your face just popped into my head, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"I would really appreciate your advice.
Do you have any good ideas...?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...If I recall,
I heard rumors about it from my homeroom teacher.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to Fuji Kiseki,
Jungle Pocket listens with intense focus.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It seemed her deep admiration made her hang on to every single word.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
...I see. If that's the case,
asking Fuji-san might be
the right choice!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Let's go search right away!
Pokke-chan, just hang in there, okay!

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
Fuji-san? Haven't seen her around.
If I bump into her, I'll be sure to let her know
that Top Road was looking for her!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much!
If you ever run into any trouble,
I'll be the one to help you next time!

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, you're totally exaggerating~.
You're always the one helping me
with studying and stuff anyway!

text_block_list.name: Senior Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Fuji? Ah, if you're looking for her,
one of the girls in the dorm felt sick,
so she accompanied her to the hospital.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Huh!? I-Is that so?

text_block_list.name: Senior Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
An emergency? Want me to call someone for you?
Uhh, where's my phone, my phone...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Wah-wah, I'm alright here.
Thank you so much for looking out for me!

text_block_list.name: Senior Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Yeah? Oh, anyway, thanks for helping out the other day! You really saved us with clearing out the gym shed~! We just didn't have enough hands on deck.

text_block_list.name: Senior Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: You're always the one helping me out, after all. Next time you're in trouble, just say the word. I'll absolutely come to your rescue♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seemed difficult to ask Fuji Kiseki.
However, in the meantime,
many Umamusume offered their help.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Everyone placed their trust in Narita Top Road,
openly expressing their daily gratitude.
choice_data_list: You're always there supporting everyone, aren't you?
You're always helping everyone out, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: "That's not... But, I do hope to become like that."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
There are many times when things don't go as we hope.
When our own strength isn't enough,
or when we simply don't know what to do.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: "So, at times like that, at the very least... I'd like to support and deliver the very strength that cheers that person up."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh, wait. Before that, we have to think
of a countermeasure! Hmmm...
Without Fuji-san here..."
choice_data_list: I'll just have to imitate Fuji Kiseki...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
A-An impression!? The only impressions I can do are dogs and cats...
N-No! But I'll do my very best!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
S-Surprise! Er, were you surpri... sed?
If you apply the formula from earlier here, the answer
just pops right out, which means... wait, what's my line again??

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Did ya get it?", "Didst thou grasp it?"... um,
no, "Got it, right?" "Did yo..." Ah!
"Did ya copy that, little pony!" That's the one!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. If it were anyone else, I'd have kicked 'em to the curb
by now. But I can tell you're completely dead serious...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Guh...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Fuji-san came by my room earlier just to check if I'd been found. Sounds like she went all over searching for me.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
...Thanks a lot!
I won't let your feelings go to waste.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After that, they held a grueling study session until after school, and Jungle Pocket somehow barely managed to avoid a failing grade.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Focus on what we can do... you're right.
That's all we can do.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
All right. I'll make a practice test with guessed questions for the make-up exam!
If we focus on those, maybe...!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Hey, how's this?
There weren't that many questions, so
I feel like I actually nailed it!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Amazing, every single answer...
has been completely written in!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, easy peasy!
Thanks, Top Road!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Come on, let's check our answers and review together!
If we do that, you'll be sure to ace the makeup exam!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though almost all the answers filled in were wrong,
having made an attempt made it much easier
to pinpoint the cause of the mistakes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The next day, Jungle Pocket reported
that she had successfully avoided failing grades.
